name: dev.sam-mesh/mesh
title: Agent Mesh
description: Discover and call remote MCP tools as your own authenticated Agent Mesh member.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMESH_CONTROL_PLANE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Control plane URL supplied by your mesh operator. HTTPS is required beyond loopback unless explicitly permitted below.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMESH_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a bootstrap token file for first enrollment. Set this OR AGENTMESH_JWT_PATH; leave both empty only when resuming saved credentials.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMESH_JWT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to an OIDC/workload token file. Alternative to the bootstrap token; reread during credential refresh.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMESH_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute directory for this client identity. Use a distinct directory per client and mesh. If omitted, uses ~/.config/agentmesh/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTMESH_INSECURE_CONTROL_PLANE
environmentVariables.description: Allow plaintext HTTP beyond loopback. Development only: exposes enrollment traffic to the network.
